notes: Read both target units and full context. Preserve the imagined-post-capitalist framing and the reported, unattributed saying rather than asserting it as fact. Do not turn rhetorical questions into unconditional promises or forecasts; omit the page header and slogan repetition.

claims.claim_text: An imagined post-capitalist future includes freedom from worrying about rent, loan payments, college saving or food affordability.
An unattributed saying describes imagining capitalism's end as harder than imagining the world's end.
Support for pursuing an end to capitalism even if a post-capitalist society is difficult to imagine.
Workers deserve better living conditions than capitalism provides.
